EN:
Get me eight pelts from panthers in this area.

You look like someone who appreciates a fair deal. We set up camp here because it's an ideal starting point for hunting expeditions, unfortunately some of those annoying tree-huggers are getting in our way. They call themselves Guardians of the Forest. Anyway there's a shipment we need to deliver, but we're still short some pelts. Could you get them for us?
There are a lot of panthers with adequate pelts in these woods. We hunt for the thrill of the kill, let others worry about quality! That's our motto.
PTBR:
Consigam-me oito peles de panteras nesta área.

Vocês parecem gente que aprecia um negócio justo. Montamos o acampamento aqui porque é um ponto de partida ideal para expedições de caça; infelizmente uns abraçadores de árvores irritantes estão no nosso caminho. Eles se autodenominam Guardiões da Floresta. Enfim, há um lote que precisamos entregar, mas ainda estamos com falta de peles. Vocês poderiam consegui-las para nós?
Há muitas panteras com peles adequadas nestas matas. Nós caçamos pela emoção da matança; deixem os outros se preocuparem com a qualidade! Esse é o nosso lema.

EN:
Kill Magmadur, the Dragon!

Hello sister. As you know, the Seraphim and the dragons were once allies, but that was long ago. Recently the dragon Magmadur has become a thorn in our side. He's been destroying Temples and has devastated the area several times. That alone wouldn't be reason for violence, but he also killed our sister Katharina! She tried to reason with him, and he killed her just for that! Sophia has ordered us to end his miserable existence. Are you willing to punish Magmadur for his crimes? I'll send you to his cave right away.
PTBR:
Matem Magmadur, o Dragão!

Olá, irmã. Como você sabe, as Serafim e os dragões um dia foram aliados, mas isso foi há muito tempo. Recentemente o dragão Magmadur virou um espinho no nosso lado. Ele vem destruindo Templos e devastou a área várias vezes. Só isso já não seria razão para violência, mas ele também matou a nossa irmã Katharina! Ela tentou conversar com ele, e ele a matou só por isso! Sophia ordenou que acabássemos com a existência miserável dele. Você está disposta a punir Magmadur pelos crimes dele? Mandarei você à caverna dele imediatamente.

EN:

EN:
Free Bacalio's father from prison.

The injustice! Oh, the injustice! I could pull my hair out. I know it doesn't make things better, but what am I supposed to do?

My father was tried and sentenced for treason, but he is innocent. The judge has confiscated my father's possessions and kept them for himself. It was a set-up! The target was my father's land. He will be executed soon. My family is desperate. We don't know what to do. Everything has been taken from us. The gold isn't important, I only care about my father, who is rotting away in a dungeon cell.

Will you help us? Please free my father, so we can flee from this town.
